name: creativity-is-engineering
description: Creativity dimensions with stable gate ids. An insight that only lives in chat is not creativity.

dimensions.title: 不删优势
dimensions.summary: If the operator names a behavior as an advantage, lock it. Humanize stays on; delay is not 0 and not uniform.

dimensions.title: 先分段再动
dimensions.summary: No timing, no optimization. Parallel stages use max, not sum.

dimensions.title: 一种失败一种动作
dimensions.summary: The first creative output is a classifier table and a failing test, not a faster fill().

dimensions.title: 三张皮一层肉
dimensions.summary: HTTP, IPC, and tests converge on one service. Identity, network, and behavior write as one bundle.

dimensions.title: 包装边界
dimensions.summary: Fallback URLs live in the manifest. ESM outside asar cannot see modules inside asar.

dimensions.title: 洞察必须落盘
dimensions.summary: A chat insight is unfinished until it has a gate id, an example, and a changelog line.

dimensions.title: 创造会话收尾
dimensions.summary: This session extracts laws. Seven-step execution lives in build-standard. Landing needs a new id or example.

dimensions.title: 标准自检
dimensions.summary: Gate ids are two-way consistent. Active block gates must be cited in examples.

dimensions.title: 后法不打前法
dimensions.summary: A later law does not contradict an earlier active id in the same product.

dimensions.title: 新法不是换皮
dimensions.summary: A new id is not a restatement of an existing one.

dimensions.title: 来自战场
dimensions.summary: The law came from a named battlefield, not a thought experiment.

dimensions.title: 例子能回溯
dimensions.summary: The example points at a session, commit, or public repo, not an anonymous proverb.
